beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Interrupted grading analysis now resumes safely after a restart and explains when repeated interruptions require teacher review.

Fixes:
• Fixed grading queue races that could lose resumed work or close the queue before pending jobs were restored.
• Fixed crash-loop recovery cleanup so one worker cannot remove another worker's state and clean quits do not consume retry protection.
• Jobs that the crash-loop guard has given up on no longer auto-retry repeatedly; their interrupted reason is shown in the review panel.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
